fields.name: business-description
fields.placeholder: At Mrs. Turbo’s Cookies, we are a retro-themed ‘50s style bakery that delivers cookies and treats that are all natural with no additives or preservatives. These thick, chewy, and positively addicting delights are not your average cookie.

fields.name: founder-story
fields.placeholder: In 2012, I found my passion for baking again when my husband commented that there weren’t any good cookies in Columbus, Ohio. Well, not one to let a challenge pass me by, I took it to heart and started baking again. It became my outlet for relief for my special corporate job.
